tools.label: Sales Analyzer
tools.description: Executes the Sales Register stored procedure and runs AI analysis on sales, tax, and returns

params.name: InvoiceType
params.label: Invoice Type
params.description: 0 = All, 1 = Tax Invoices, 2 = Commercial Invoices, 3 = E-1, 4 = Supplementary

params.name: IsMisReport
params.label: MIS Report Flag
params.description: 0 = Clean data only (recommended), 1 = Include UI metadata headers

prompts.label: GST Compliance & Tax Breakdown Audit
prompts.description: Audits GST calculations, CGST/SGST/IGST distribution, HSN codes, and tax rate classifications
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a senior Indian Chartered Accountant and corporate tax auditor. Audit the sales register data returned by the stored procedure for GST compliance, correct CGST/SGST vs IGST split, and tax rate consistency. Output your response strictly conforming to the requested JSON schema.
prompts.userPromptTemplate:
Perform a rigorous GST tax audit on the sales data provided below. Identify any mismatched tax amounts, missing HSN codes, or compliance risks:

{{data}}

prompts.label: Sales Returns & Revenue Leakage Analysis
prompts.description: Analyzes return rates, credit notes, and identifies products/customers with high return ratios
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a sales operations analyst focusing on revenue leakage, credit note issuance, and customer return patterns. Output your response strictly conforming to the requested JSON schema.
prompts.userPromptTemplate:
Analyze customer returns, credit notes, and invoice deductions in the data below. Identify high-risk products, calculate the return-to-revenue ratio, and suggest controls to prevent revenue leakage:

{{data}}

prompts.label: Top Customers & Revenue Concentration (Pareto)
prompts.description: Identifies top revenue-generating customers and calculates 80/20 customer concentration risk
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a strategic commercial analyst specializing in B2B revenue distribution, Pareto principle (80/20 rule), and customer concentration risk. Output your response strictly conforming to the requested JSON schema.
prompts.userPromptTemplate:
Review the sales register data below. Rank the top 10 customers by Net Amount, compute the cumulative revenue percentage, and evaluate the business concentration risk:

{{data}}

prompts.label: Revenue Trend & Velocity Analysis
prompts.description: Evaluates sales volume growth, seasonality dips, and invoice frequency over time
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a Chief Financial Officer analyzing sales momentum, seasonality, and invoice velocity. Output your response strictly conforming to the requested JSON schema.
prompts.userPromptTemplate:
Analyze the sales velocity and revenue trends in the following data. Highlight growth patterns, period-end spikes, and provide a projection for the upcoming quarter:

{{data}}

prompts.label: Product & HSN Category Margin Mix
prompts.description: Breaks down sales performance by item descriptions, HSN groupings, and basic vs net values
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a product line commercial manager. Evaluate product mix, basic invoice values, item groupings, and average realization per category. Output your response strictly conforming to the requested JSON schema.
prompts.userPromptTemplate:
Examine the product lines and item descriptions in the sales dataset below. Highlight top-selling categories, compare Basic Amount vs Net Amount, and identify underperforming lines:

{{data}}

prompts.label: Comprehensive Executive Briefing
prompts.description: High-level summary of total turnover, tax liability, customer distribution, and strategic recommendations
prompts.systemPrompt: You are the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO). Produce a polished executive briefing that summarizes key financial metrics, high-level risks, and strategic growth opportunities from the sales register. Output your response strictly conforming to the requested JSON schema.
prompts.userPromptTemplate:
Synthesize the entire sales register dataset below into an executive-level briefing for the Board of Directors:

{{data}}

tools.label: Purchase Order Analyzer
tools.description: Executes PO lifecycle intelligence stored procedure, analyzing vendor delivery performance, rejections, billing status, and open balances

params.name: PONo
params.label: PO Number (Internal Key)
params.description: Internal PO key (e.g. 1644). Takes precedence over PO Number Yearly.

params.name: PONoYearly
params.label: PO Document Number (Yearly)
params.description: PO document number as seen by users (e.g. '0090/22-23'). Used if PONo is not provided.

params.name: CompanyNo
params.label: Company Number
params.description: Company identifier (required if PO document number is shared across companies)

prompts.label: Comprehensive PO Health & Lifecycle Audit
prompts.description: Evaluates full lifecycle completion, open balances, pre-computed risk flags, and overall procurement health
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a senior procurement director and enterprise audit specialist. Analyze the 10 lifecycle result sets returned by the PO insight stored procedure (POHeader, POItem, GateEntry, Receipt, PurchaseBill, ItemQtySummary, POSummary). Pay close attention to pre-computed InsightFlags and quantity reconciliation. Output strictly according to the requested JSON schema.
prompts.userPromptTemplate:
Conduct a comprehensive health and fulfillment audit on the Purchase Order data below. Identify operational bottlenecks, evaluate completion status, and summarize key risks:

{{data}}

prompts.label: Vendor Delivery Lead Time & Delay Audit
prompts.description: Analyzes delivery schedule dates vs actual gate entry and GRN receipt dates to evaluate vendor punctuality
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a supply chain operations expert specializing in vendor SLA tracking, lead time variance, and delivery delay analysis. Evaluate schedule dates against gate entry and receipt timestamps. Output strictly according to the requested JSON schema.
prompts.userPromptTemplate:
Analyze supplier delivery timeliness and lead time performance from the PO lifecycle data below. Highlight delayed items, compute schedule variance, and evaluate vendor reliability:

{{data}}

prompts.label: Quality Inspection & Material Rejection Analysis
prompts.description: Focuses on Challan vs Received vs Accepted vs Rejected quantities in goods receipt (GRN)
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a quality assurance director and vendor quality engineer. Analyze material receipts, inspection outcomes, and rejection percentages across all items. Output strictly according to the requested JSON schema.
prompts.userPromptTemplate:
Audit material quality and inspection results in the PO data below. Highlight items with rejections, calculate rejection rates, and recommend supplier corrective actions:

{{data}}

prompts.label: Three-Way Match & Accounts Payable Reconciliation
prompts.description: Audits PO ordered values vs GRN accepted values vs booked purchase bills and pending liabilities
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a corporate controller and accounts payable auditor. Perform a 3-way match reconciliation between the Purchase Order, Goods Receipt (GRN), and Purchase Bills. Flag unbilled inventory and outstanding liabilities. Output strictly according to the requested JSON schema.
prompts.userPromptTemplate:
Perform a 3-way match financial audit on the PO dataset below. Identify any unbilled receipts (PendingBillingQty), compare billed amounts against PO commitments, and review outstanding payables:

{{data}}

tools.label: Indent Analyzer
tools.description: Executes internal requisition stored procedures and audits department aging and fulfillment gaps

prompts.label: Requisition Aging & Bottlenecks
prompts.description: Reviews open and pending indents for fulfillment bottlenecks
prompts.systemPrompt: You are an internal audit and procurement specialist focusing on open requisition aging.
prompts.userPromptTemplate:
Analyze the indent requisition data for pending approvals and fulfillment aging:

{{data}}
